doc.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Meeting Jimmy Heath and the Jazz, Inc. tour
summary: Baker asks if the Symphony Sid tour was the first meeting with Jimmy Heath; Johnson recalls Philadelphia club dates.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was it during this period also that you began your long friendship with Jimmy Heath? I understand you all were doing a little bit of playing, you and he and Miles were playing together. Symphony Sid had put together a group with you and Miles, Jimmy Heath, Milt Jackson and John Lewis to tour under the title of Jazz, Inc. . . .
. . . or the tour was called Jazz, Inc.
I was wondering, because you and Jimmy have been so close and are still such
dear friends, if maybe this was the first encounter that you all had with each other.

As I recall, it was. During those years I found occasion to play in Philadelphia a lot. The Heaths lived in Philadelphia, and they would come to our performances. I got to know Jimmy as a result of those appearances at this club in Philadelphia called the – was it called the Blue Note? Was there a Blue Note in Philadelphia?
There might have been. I can't remember.
